title: Conditioned in Training, Dispensable at Inference: Typological Conditioning for Multilingual Speech Translation
abstract: arXiv:2605.16026v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multilingual speech translation frontends built on speech large language models typically condition on language identity, as a learned embedding or a prompted language name. Such a signal, however, is learned separately for each language and transfers nothing between typologically related languages. In this paper, we present TypoCast, a frontend that conditions on the typological profile of the source language rather than on its label alone. A typology-informed hierarchical language encoding represents each language by its morphological type, constituent order and family, so that supervision is shared among related languages. A dual-route mixture-of-experts adapter routes inputs through a shared typological route together with a per-language residual, and a typology-aware prompt conveys the same profile to the decoder. translated_title: 训练时调节，推理时可省略：面向多语言语音翻译的类型学调节
translated_abstract: 基于语音大语言模型构建的多语言语音翻译前端通常以语言身份作为条件，例如通过学习到的嵌入向量或提示中的语言名称。然而，这样的信号是针对每种语言单独学习的，无法在类型学上相关的语言之间实现迁移。在本文中，我们提出了TypoCast，一种以源语言的类型学特征而非仅仅以其标签作为条件的前端。类型学感知的层次化语言编码通过形态类型、语序和语系来表示每种语言，使相关语言之间能够共享监督信息。双路由混合专家适配器将输入通过共享的类型学路由与每种语言特有的残差路由进行处理，同时类型学感知的提示将相同的语言特征传递给解码器。在CVSS-C数据集上的大量实验表明，TypoCast超越了最先进的语音到语音翻译方法。
tldr: TypoCast通过以源语言的类型学特征（形态类型、语序、语系）而非语言标签作为条件，实现相关语言间的监督共享，在多语言语音翻译中超越了现有最优方法。
en_tdlr: TypoCast conditions on the typological profile of the source language (morphology, word order, and family) rather than language labels, enabling supervision sharing across related languages and surpassing state-of-the-art multilingual speech translation.
